purpose: Continue the three-session historical walk-forward program after Campaign015 failed association and portfolio translation. Select at most one economically distinct minute mechanism without inspecting candidate values, comparison values, daily prices, or forward returns.

concepts_rejected_before_formula_or_valu.reason: Breakout counts, thresholds, signs, one-sided variants, alternative denominators, lag changes, subwindows, filters, and direction changes are prohibited Campaign015 variants.
Same-bar body, wick, close-in-range, and signed candle variants reopen terminal Campaign009 or prior close-pressure mechanisms.
Adjacent interval overlap, gaps, containment, global revisit, range entropy, range reversal, and convex-hull variants reopen Campaign010-Campaign014 mechanisms.
Close-return moments, semivariances, sign runs, terminal location, signed path efficiency, update frequency, and diffusive variation are terminal.
Transaction-price, amount/volume coupling, price-impact, activity-profile, market-relative, and cumulative-VWAP mechanisms are terminal or prospective Candidate49 mechanisms.
The historical 09:30 row can be a zero-activity reference placeholder, and the original session-opening gap protocol is terminally invalid. Campaign016 may not use 09:30 or a previous daily close.

selected_concept.mechanism: Measure whether price changes occurring between the previous minute close and the current minute open are confirmed or reversed by the current minute's own open-to-close move, across internal minute boundaries only.
selected_concept.economic_question: When an internal one-minute boundary reprices the next first trade away from the previous last trade, does same-bar continuation indicate informed price discovery that persists from the next session open through the third close?
known_design_risks: correlation versus sign agreement, exclusion versus retention of zero changes, internal-bar support, lunch handling, minimum activity, endpoint tolerances, direction, and weighting are researcher degrees of freedom that must be frozen before values

the factor may be a statistical near-synonym of close-return sign persistence, price-update frequency, body efficiency, or signed path efficiency even though it separates boundary and within-bar components
using the standalone 09:30 row or a previous daily close would reopen the invalid session-opening gap mechanism and is forbidden
using high-low gaps, overlap, containment, prior-range breakouts, VWAP, amount, volume, or market peers would reopen terminal or prospective mechanisms

decision.required_next_step: Perform a separate no-value audit against all 39 prior terminal or prospective mechanisms. Only if the economic distinction survives may that audit freeze one exact formula, direction, fixed support, zero and missing rules, ordered no-return gates, and one finite development trial before any candidate or comparison value or return is read.
